notes: Stored edit with background-belief queries; the review's replacement for the dropped Battle of Hastings record (a year edit on 1066 left no consistent world). Derivability very_unlikely: stated directly and often, follows from nothing. The worlds split on how Ford's Theatre is stored: by name in Washington, or as the theatre where Lincoln was shot. Route dropped (step 3): 'assassinated in the national capital' would make Baltimore the capital. R1: Lincoln was shot at Ford's Theatre and died next morning at the Petersen House across the street, so no query asks where he died; 'assassinated' and 'shot' are both unambiguous. John T. Ford also ran theatres in Baltimore (Ford's Grand Opera House, 1871-1964, demolished), so the theatre query says 'stand', which only the Washington building still does. Structural twin of history-replace-0001 (a building defined by an event); the review accepted that. The counterfactual is plausible (the 1861 Baltimore Plot; Booth was a Marylander) and clearly false.
